info.title: Storage Cache Mgmt Client

requests.description: Lists all of the available Resource Provider operations.
requests.name: GET /providers/Microsoft.StorageCache/operations

requests.description: Returns all Caches the user has access to under a subscription.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.StorageCache/caches
requests.note: Replace {{STORAGE_CACHE_MGMT_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get the list of StorageCache.Cache SKUs available to this subscription.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.StorageCache/skus

requests.description: Tells a Cache to write all dirty data to the Storage Target(s). During the flush, clients will see errors returned until the flush is complete.
requests.name: POST /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.StorageCache/caches/{cacheName}/flush
requests.note: Replace {{STORAGE_CACHE_MGMT_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Tells a Stopped state Cache to transition to Active state.
requests.name: POST /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.StorageCache/caches/{cacheName}/start
requests.note: Replace {{STORAGE_CACHE_MGMT_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Tells an Active Cache to transition to Stopped state.
requests.name: POST /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.StorageCache/caches/{cacheName}/stop
requests.note: Replace {{STORAGE_CACHE_MGMT_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a list of Storage Targets for the specified Cache.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.StorageCache/caches/{cacheName}/storageTargets
requests.note: Replace {{STORAGE_CACHE_MGMT_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Removes a Storage Target from a Cache. This operation is allowed at any time, but if the Cache is down or unhealthy, the actual removal of the Storage Target may be delayed until the Cache is healthy again. Note that if the Cache has data to flush to the Storage Target, the data will be flushed before the Storage Target will be deleted.
requests.name: DELETE /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.StorageCache/caches/{cacheName}/storageTargets/{storageTargetName}
requests.note: Replace {{STORAGE_CACHE_MGMT_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a Storage Target from a Cache.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.StorageCache/caches/{cacheName}/storageTargets/{storageTargetName}
requests.note: Replace {{STORAGE_CACHE_MGMT_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Create or update a Storage Target. This operation is allowed at any time, but if the Cache is down or unhealthy, the actual creation/modification of the Storage Target may be delayed until the Cache is healthy again.
requests.name: PUT /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.StorageCache/caches/{cacheName}/storageTargets/{storageTargetName}
requests.note: Replace {{STORAGE_CACHE_MGMT_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Upgrade a Cache's firmware if a new version is available. Otherwise, this operation has no effect.
requests.name: POST /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.StorageCache/caches/{cacheName}/upgrade
requests.note: Replace {{STORAGE_CACHE_MGMT_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
